mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, title, content, action_type, status, status_type, icon, related_id, related_type, create_time FROM sys_activity_log ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_activity_log (user_id, user_name, title, content, action_type, status, status_type, icon, related_id, related_type, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{actionType}, #{status}, #{statusType}, #{icon}, #{relatedId}, #{relatedType}, #{createTime})
